title: Learning Sequential Decisions from Multiple Sources via Group-Robust Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2602.01825v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning a common policy from multiple source environments requires accounting for cross-source heterogeneity, and the offline setting introduces an additional challenge of limited data coverage. We formulate this problem as a distributionally robust Markov decision process under a shared linear MDP representation with source-specific transition and reward components. The uncertainty set is constructed through feature-wise mixtures of these components, yielding a $d$-rectangular structure that captures cross-source heterogeneity and admits a robust Bellman recursion. Building on this formulation, we develop Group-Robust Pessimistic Value Iteration (GR-PEVI), an offline policy-learning algorithm that combines feature-wise worst-case aggregation with a data-dependent pessimism penalty. translated_title: 通过群体鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程从多源环境中学习序贯决策
translated_abstract: 从多个源环境中学习一个共同策略需要考虑跨源异质性，而离线设置还带来了数据覆盖有限的额外挑战。我们将该问题表述为在共享线性MDP表示下的分布鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程，该表示包含源特定的转移和奖励组件。不确定性集通过这些组件的按特征混合来构建，产生了一个d-矩形结构，该结构既能刻画跨源异质性，又支持鲁棒Bellman递归。基于此表述，我们开发了群体鲁棒悲观值迭代（GR-PEVI），这是一种离线策略学习算法，它将按特征的最坏情况聚合与数据依赖的悲观惩罚相结合。在鲁棒部分覆盖条件下，我们为GR-PEVI建立了有限样本次优性保证，并将该分析扩展至聚类的源环境情形（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出基于共享线性MDP表示的d-矩形分布鲁棒决策框架及GR-PEVI离线算法，通过按特征最坏情况聚合与数据依赖悲观惩罚，在鲁棒部分覆盖条件下实现了跨源异质多环境序贯决策学习的有限样本次优性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributionally robust MDP framework with a d-rectangular uncertainty set and the GR-PEVI offline algorithm, achieving finite-sample suboptimality guarantees for learning a common policy across heterogeneous source environments under a robust partial coverage condition.
